question: ** Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Personel**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**Personnel**." • The word refers to the employees or staff of an organization. (किसी संगठन के कर्मचारी) • **Example**: *The company hired new personnel to strengthen its team.* • The error in spelling is the omission of one "**n**" and one "**e**." Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Appreciate **means to recognize the value or quality of something/someone. (किसी चीज़/किसी के मूल्य या गुणवत्ता को पहचानना) • **Passenger **refers to a person who is travelling in a vehicle or on public transportation. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी वाहन या सार्वजनिक परिवहन पर यात्रा कर रहा हो) • **Complaint **means an expression of dissatisfaction or criticism. (असंतोष या आलोचना की अभिव्यक्ति) 3b:T5b0, The correct answer is: **not allowed to go**
